title: Weekly Average
description: Compares a route's current-year weekday-vs-weekend speed pattern against the same route one and two years ago.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210402, cross-referenced against the snap row's route_comps->graphIds (this page predates _measurePick, same as Bi-directional/Snapshot). Smallest template in the catalog: only 2 real graphs, 3 comps, all fed by the SAME live graphId for the LineGraph (comp-1/2/3) plus one comp-1-only BarGraph. Per apply_today_relative_patches.py's own REPORTS[2210402] patch ('nothing dropped, already exactly 3 comps'), comp-1/2/3 map to Current Year/1 Year Ago/2 Years Ago (comp-1's live name, 'Long Long Long Long Long Name Here', was flagged in the patch script itself as 'placeholder-looking test name' -- not real content to preserve). Unified the 3 comps under one shared route_slot_group (the live DB had comp-1 on group $0 but comp-2/3 on a separate group 5899 -- an inconsistent legacy split, not a real 2nd-corridor concept; this report's own name/description imply a single corridor viewed across 3 relative periods, matching every other single-direction template's one-slot-group pattern). The single BarGraph's resolution wasn't recoverable from the section itself (pre-_measurePick), but the report's own name ('Weekly Average') and its snap row's description text ('an average weekday profile with the weekend separated out') directly names a weekday/weekend split -- used resolution:"weekday" on Current Year only, matching its live single-comp feed exactly.
